slug.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens

version.invalid: Use 1 to 4 numbers separated by dots, for example 3.2.1

url.httpOnly: Only http and https URLs are allowed

step.targetRequired: Choose the element this step acts on
step.valueRequired: Enter a value for this step

step.manualInGlobalStep: Global steps need an automatic action in every step

locator.required: Enter how to find the element

invite.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. Copy it again from the message you received.

appSettings.restoreBody: It will appear in lists again and can be edited.
appSettings.readOnly: Only application managers can change these settings.

orgSettings.title: Organization settings

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts

scenarios.noMatchesBody: Try other words or remove some filters.

scenario.descriptionPlaceholder: What this scenario covers and why it matters…
scenario.stepsToReachPlaceholder: Preconditions, test data and how to get there. Use headings for separate sections.
scenario.author: Created
scenario.casesBody: Test cases verify this scenario with steps and expected results. A test case can verify several scenarios.
scenario.deleteBody: It disappears from the scenario list but keeps its key, history, comments and attachments. You can restore it later.
scenario.deletedBanner: This scenario was deleted {{when}} by {{name}}. It is read-only until it is restored.

form.label: Scenario

form.tagsHint: Shown as Playwright tags, for example @smoke.

editor.linkPrompt: Link URL (leave empty to remove the link)

testCases.searchPlaceholder: Search by key, title or step…
testCases.emptyBody: A test case checks one behavior of one or more scenarios with steps and expected results. testRex runs it with Playwright, or a tester follows it by hand.

modeHint.automated: testRex runs the steps with Playwright and checks every assertion.
modeHint.manual: A tester follows the steps and records what happened.

testCases.scenariosHint: One or more scenarios this test case verifies.
testCases.noDatasetHint: Choose a dataset to run once per row.
testCases.descriptionPlaceholder: What this test case checks and why…
testCases.preconditionsPlaceholder: State, data and access needed before the first step…
testCases.stepsHintAutomated: Actions run with Playwright; assertions are the expected results and stand out.
testCases.stepsHintManual: Describe each step and its expected result; testers mark each step as they go.
testCases.conflictBody: {{name}} saved v{{version}} {{when}}. Copy your changes, or load the latest version (your changes are lost).
testCases.deleteBody: It leaves the catalog and new runs but keeps its key, versions and past results. You can restore it later.
testCases.beforeEachNote: Before each test case, these global steps run first: {{names}}.
testCases.datasetRuns_one: Runs once for each row of “{{name}}” ({{count}} row). Columns:
testCases.datasetRuns_other: Runs once for each row of “{{name}}” ({{count}} rows). Columns:
testCases.codeIntro: Generated from the steps with the application's base URL, global steps and dataset. testRex executes the same steps.
testCases.restoreVersionBody: Its content becomes v{{next}}. Later versions stay in the history.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.intro: Datasets hold test data. A test case that uses one runs once per row, and its steps can use the column names as variables.
datasets.newBody: Columns become variables for steps; each row is one execution.
datasets.name: Name
datasets.emptyBody: Create one or import a CSV file to run test cases with several sets of data.
datasets.iterationsHint_one: Test cases that use this dataset run {{count}} time.
datasets.iterationsHint_other: Test cases that use this dataset run {{count}} times.
datasets.deleteBody: Test cases must stop using it first. Past runs keep their data.
datasets.csvEmpty: The CSV file has no header line.

automation.baseUrlHint: Relative “go to” steps open pages on this address. Runs can override it.
automation.assertionHint: How long assertions retry before failing (ms).
automation.globalStepsIntro: Global steps run around every automated test case or run, like Playwright hooks. The before-run steps run once and share their browser state (for example a sign-in) with every test case.

phaseHints.beforeRun: Runs once; the cookies and storage it leaves are the starting state of every test case. If it fails, automated test cases are blocked.
phaseHints.beforeEach: Runs at the start of every test case and dataset row. A failure fails that test case.
phaseHints.afterEach: Runs after every test case, even when it failed.
phaseHints.afterRun: Runs once at the end; failures are shown in the run report.

runs.newBody: Choose scenarios (their test cases that are not deprecated) and/or individual test cases. Each test case runs once.
runs.titleHint: Optional; a title is suggested from the selection.
runs.scenariosHint: All their test cases are included.
runs.emptyBody: A run executes test cases: automated ones in a browser with Playwright, manual ones step by step by testers.
runs.completeBody_one: {{count}} test case that was not executed will be marked as skipped.
runs.completeBody_other: {{count}} test cases that were not executed will be marked as skipped.
runs.cancelBody: Automated test cases stop before their next step; everything not finished is skipped.
runs.missingResult: Choose the result of row {{number}} before saving.
runs.screenshotAlt: Screenshot of the page when row {{iteration}} failed

reports.emptyBody: Start a test run to see trends, failures and flaky test cases here.
reports.columnLabel: {{run}}: {{passed}} passed, {{failed}} failed, {{blocked}} blocked, {{skipped}} skipped, pass rate {{rate}}
reports.passRatePanel: Pass rate of each run, from 0 to 100 percent
reports.flakyBody: Both passed and failed in this period.
reports.scenarioHealthBody: Pass rate of the executions of each scenario's test cases, lowest first.

recorder.title: Record steps
recorder.description: Record in a browser that testRex runs for you, or import code recorded with Playwright codegen.
recorder.liveIntro: testRex opens the page in a browser on the worker. Click and type on the live view: every action becomes a step with a locator that matches exactly that element.
recorder.viewLabel: Live view of the recorded page. Click to interact, type to enter text.
recorder.help: Click to interact. In assertion mode, click an element to check it. Typing goes to the focused field; Enter, Backspace, arrows and Escape are sent too. Press Tab to leave the live view.
recorder.importIntro: Record locally with the official Playwright recorder, then paste the generated code. Supported lines become steps.

ai.generateBody: Proposals for {{scenario}}. Nothing is saved until you create them.
ai.generatePlaceholder: For example: focus on invalid coupons and edge cases
ai.issues_one: {{count}} part of the answer was dropped
ai.issues_other: {{count}} parts of the answer were dropped
ai.thinking: The model is working… this can take up to a minute.
ai.reviseBody: Describe the change. You review the proposal before it is saved.
ai.revisePlaceholder: For example: verify the cart total after applying the coupon
ai.changedMeanwhile: The test case changed meanwhile. Reload it and ask again.
ai.fixBody: The model sees the failure in {{run}}: the failing step, the error, the page URL and the page structure.
ai.fixPlaceholder: Optional: anything you know about the failure

aiSettings.title: AI assistance
aiSettings.body: Connect an LLM provider to generate, improve and fix test cases. The key is encrypted and never shown again.

modelHints.openai_compatible: The model name of your endpoint, for example gpt-5 or llama3.1.

aiSettings.baseUrlHint: The URL that comes before /chat/completions, for example http://ollama:11434/v1.
aiSettings.keyHint: Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.
aiSettings.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it, or enter a new one.
aiSettings.clearKey: Remove the saved key (endpoints without authentication)
aiSettings.removeBody: AI actions are hidden until a provider is configured again.
